verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe publishes an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server for AI agents to query docs/API, a CLI for testing integrations, and a built-in simulated reader for testing without hardware — all of which support programmatic/API exploration. However, there's no direct evidence of an interactive, runnable-example API reference page (docs.stripe.com/api or similar), and a probe for openapi.json/swagger.json at expected doc paths returned 404s, undermining a clean 'full' claim.
